title: Templates
description:
Fill `{name}` placeholders in text with `gsub` and a function.

```
fill("Hello {name}, you have {count} messages", { name = "Ada", count = 3 })
-> Hello Ada, you have 3 messages
fill("Hi {who}", {}) -> Hi {who}
fill("Price: {price:%.2f}", { price = 4.5 }) -> Price: 4.50
```

starter.main.lua:
local function fill(template, values)
  return template
end

print(fill("Hello {name}, you have {count} messages", { name = "Ada", count = 3 }))

hints: `template:gsub("{(%w+):?([^}]*)}", function(name, fmt) ... end)`; returning `nil` from the function keeps the original text (lesson 4.03).
`(fill(...))` in brackets keeps only the first result of `gsub`, which also returns a count.
requirements: `fill(template, values)` with `string.gsub` and a replacement function.
An unknown name is left as it was.
An optional format after `:` is passed to `string.format`.
stretch: Allow `{{` and `}}` to write literal braces.
